works.author: Phenomenon Labs for Phenomenon Studio
works.comment: 环境合规软件 Ama Earth 官网：整屏航拍森林与公路作底，大标题“Deliver physical world compliance reports in hours, not months.”，下方 BOOK A DEMO 与 CLAIM FREE CREDITS 两个入口；合规工具用“一幅航拍大图 + 一句几小时出报告”把枯燥的环境合规讲得有画面感。
works.comment_en: Ama Earth, an environmental compliance software site: a full-bleed aerial of forest and highway carries the headline "Deliver physical world compliance reports in hours, not months.", with Book a Demo and Claim Free Credits below; a compliance tool makes environmental reporting vivid with one aerial photograph and one promise of reports in hours.
works.title: Environmental Software Website Design – Ama Earth

works.author: uixNinja
works.comment: AI 花费与 Agent 遥测仪表盘 Tokenwise：左上 Token Usage 4.3M 配模型切换，中间 Spend & Savings $1,180 与 Model Speed & Cache 80% 命中率，右上 API Billing Wallet $14,250 余额配 Auto-Refill，下方 Active Agents 按 Agent 列花费；AI 成本用“用量、花费、缓存命中率、Agent 账单”四组卡片一次讲清钱花在哪。
works.comment_en: Tokenwise, an AI spend, routing and agent telemetry dashboard: Token Usage at 4.3M with model switching up top, Spend & Savings of $1,180 beside an 80% model cache hit rate, an API Billing Wallet of $14,250 with Auto-Refill, and Active Agents broken down by cost below; AI spend reads at a glance through four card groups — usage, savings, cache, and per-agent bills.
works.title: Tokenwise — AI Spend, Routing & Agent Telemetry Dashboard

works.author: Tanvir for Yscale Studio
works.comment: 服装电商模板 SORREL：大标题“Wear it in. Wear it out.”配情侣街拍，下方“The pieces people keep coming back for.”接畅销单品墙，末尾“Fewer pieces. Better made.”收束；时尚电商用“两句短标题 + 一墙实拍单品”把少而精的品牌主张一次讲透。
works.comment_en: SORREL fashion store template: the headline "Wear it in. Wear it out." over a street-style couple shot, followed by "The pieces people keep coming back for." above a best-sellers wall, closing on "Fewer pieces. Better made."; a fashion store sells a less-but-better promise with two short headlines and one wall of photographed product.
works.title: Fashion Store Website Template

works.author: AmazingUI
works.comment: Agentic AI 买菜 App：一部手机里 Season Fruits 列表排开，百香果 $8.50/1kg、芒果 $5.99、西瓜 $4.99、杏 $3.99，底部 Cart $2.99，卡片上 0.5 kg 份量与评分一目了然；买菜 App 用“一屏水果卡片 + 单价与评分”把 AI 下单的轻快感做出来。
works.comment_en: An agentic AI grocery app: one phone shows a Season Fruits list — passion fruit $8.50/1kg, mango $5.99, watermelon $4.99, apricot $3.99 — with a $2.99 cart at the bottom and 0.5 kg portions and ratings on each card; grocery ordering feels light and fast with one screen of fruit cards carrying price and rating.
works.title: Agentic AI App - Ordering Groceries

works.author: Riko Sapto Dimo for Orely
works.comment: 奢侈香水落地页 ÉTHER：中央绿色丘陵上大写 ÉTHER，周围拼贴香水瓶、黑白男女模特、MEN'S / WOMEN'S 分类与“THE GIFT OF SCENT.”礼盒区，瓶身还带日文标注；香水电商用“一幅丘陵主视觉 + 九宫格拼贴”把高级感与选购入口叠在一屏。
works.comment_en: ÉTHER, a luxury perfume landing page: a green-hilled hero carries the ÉTHER wordmark, collaged with perfume bottles, black-and-white portraits, MEN'S and WOMEN'S collections and a "THE GIFT OF SCENT." gift section, with Japanese labels on the bottles; a fragrance store layers luxury and shopping into one screen with a hillside hero and a nine-panel collage.
works.title: ÉTHER – Luxury Perfume Landing Page

works.author: Dude Studios
works.comment: AI 资金管家 Sable：深色界面配橙蓝渐变底，大标题“Idle cash swept”，$2.1M 已划转、每月 +$8.4K 收益，右侧“Sweep idle cash above $4.2M into T-bills”配审批日志与 30 天余额柱状图；资金管理用“一个划转结果 + 一条审批时间线”让 AI 代管现金看起来可审计、可信任。
works.comment_en: Sable, an AI treasury agent: a dark interface over an orange-blue gradient leads with "Idle cash swept" — $2.1M moved, +$8.4K yield a month — beside "Sweep idle cash above $4.2M into T-bills" with an approval log and a 30-day balance chart; cash management earns trust with one sweep result plus an auditable approval timeline.
works.title: Sable: AI Treasury Agent, Dashboard & Landing Page

works.author: Imran Hossen
works.comment: 语音委托助手 Atrium：左屏“Talk to Atlas”，中央橙色光晕圆钮配“Waiting for you”，下方一句“Done. Legal's on it. I've also moved your Thursday vendor call to 3 PM.”，右侧任务清单逐项打勾、还能追问确认；语音助手用“一个光晕按钮 + 一句已办妥的回复”把委托这件事做得像真人助理。
works.comment_en: Atrium, a delegate-by-voice AI assistant: "Talk to Atlas" on the left, a glowing orange orb marked "Waiting for you" in the center, and below it "Done. Legal's on it. I've also moved your Thursday vendor call to 3 PM.", with a checklist ticking off tasks on the right; a voice assistant feels like a real aide with one glowing button and one done-deal reply.
works.title: Atrium — Delegate by voice | AI Voice Assistant Dashboard

works.author: Purrweb UI/UX Agency
works.comment: 订单管理系统 Exception queue：深棕界面上“18 stuck overnight”大字镇场，左侧未解决、重试、退款、退货四列订单卡按金额排开，右侧最长卡单 26h 05m 与处理日志；异常订单用“一个卡单总数 + 四列分流”让客服先救最急的那一批。
works.comment_en: An order management system's Exception Queue: a dark brown view leads with "18 stuck overnight", sorting order cards by amount across Unsorted, Retry, Refund and Return columns, with the longest-stuck order at 26h 05m and a handling log on the right; stuck orders read as one total plus four triage columns, so support saves the most urgent batch first.
works.title: Order Management System Web App Design
